title: 淡江大橋工程~Danjiang Bridge Engineering
focus: 以背跨錨固、縱向消能、索力與疲勞量化淡江大橋 450 m 單塔不對稱斜張橋的設計與驗證~Quantifying back-span anchorage, longitudinal energy dissipation, stay forces and fatigue for the 450 m single-pylon asymmetric Danjiang Bridge
summary: 延伸既有導覽課程，把淡江大橋主跨 450 m、背跨 175 m 的單塔不對稱配置轉成可計算的工程問題：背跨錨固力、HFR 與 FVD 縱向消能、94 根斜拉索的鋼絞線數與垂度、58 支基樁與大體積樁帽、211 m 曲面橋塔的日照偏位、26 號合龍節塊的溫度窗口、風洞與載重試驗判讀、鋼橋面疲勞壽命與 120 年監測資料的溫度修正。~Extending the existing guided course, this unit set turns the Danjiang Bridge’s single-pylon asymmetric layout, with a 450 m main span and a 175 m back span, into calculable engineering problems: back-span anchor force, longitudinal dissipation by HFR and FVD devices, strand counts and sag of the 94 stays, the 58-pile foundation and mass-concrete cap, solar sway of the 211 m curved pylon, the temperature window for closure segment no. 26, interpretation of wind-tunnel and load tests, steel-deck fatigue life and temperature correction of 120-year monitoring data.

units.anchor: 背跨錨墩拉力~Back-span anchor-pier force
units.title: 不對稱跨徑的槓桿平衡與背跨錨固~Lever balance and back-span anchorage of an asymmetric layout
units.mechanism: 淡江大橋的單塔位於河道偏淡水側，主跨 450 m 伸向八里，背跨只有 175 m。斜拉索把橋面重量吊到塔頂，塔頂兩側斜索的水平分力必須互相抵銷，否則橋塔會被拉彎；主跨長、背跨短，背索因此比前索陡，同樣的水平力在背跨端產生更大的向下拉力。若背跨本身不夠重，這個差額就要由背跨端的錨墩以拉力（或壓重）承受，背跨橋墩的支承因此可能出現上拔。設計者調整背跨壓重、錨墩配置與背索角度，就是在決定橋塔彎矩、錨墩反力與主跨撓度之間的分配。~The Danjiang Bridge’s single pylon stands toward the Tamsui side of the channel; the 450 m main span reaches toward Bali while the back span is only 175 m. Stays lift the deck weight to the pylon head, and the horizontal components of the stays on both sides must cancel or the pylon is bent. Because the main span is long and the back span short, the back stays are steeper, so the same horizontal force produces a larger downward pull at the back-span end. If the back span is not heavy enough, the difference must be carried as tension (or ballast) at the anchor pier, and back-span bearings may see uplift. Adjusting back-span ballast, anchor-pier layout and back-stay angles is how the designer distributes demand among pylon bending, anchor-pier reaction and main-span deflection.
units.model: 把全橋視為以塔為支點的槓桿：R = (w_m·L_m²/2 − w_b·L_b²/2)/L_b。取 w_m = w_b = 300 kN/m、L_m = 450 m、L_b = 175 m：R = (30,375,000 − 4,593,750)/175 ≈ 147,300 kN；若背跨壓重使 w_b = 1,000 kN/m，R 降為約 86,100 kN。數值為教學假設，非本橋設計值。~Treat the bridge as a lever about the pylon: R = (w_m·L_m²/2 − w_b·L_b²/2)/L_b. With w_m = w_b = 300 kN/m, L_m = 450 m and L_b = 175 m, R = (30,375,000 − 4,593,750)/175 ≈ 147,300 kN; ballasting the back span to w_b = 1,000 kN/m lowers R to about 86,100 kN. Values are teaching assumptions, not this bridge’s design values.
units.verify: 在施工各階段以背跨錨墩支承的荷重計或千斤頂讀值，比對施工階段分析預測的反力；同時量測塔頂縱向偏位與背索索力。若反力偏低而塔頂往主跨側偏，表示背跨壓重或背索力不足，需在合龍前調整。~At each construction stage compare load-cell or jack readings at the back-span anchor-pier bearings with reactions predicted by the staged analysis, while measuring longitudinal pylon-head displacement and back-stay forces. A low reaction together with pylon sway toward the main span indicates insufficient ballast or back-stay force, to be corrected before closure.
units.failure: 背跨壓重估算過輕或錨墩拉力構件設計不足時，滿載的主跨會把背跨支承拉離，產生支承上拔與反覆碰撞，塔頂偏位與主跨撓度同時超出預測，伸縮縫與支承提前損壞。~If back-span ballast is underestimated or the anchor-pier tie is undersized, a fully loaded main span lifts the back-span bearings off their seats, causing uplift and repeated impact; pylon-head sway and main-span deflection both exceed predictions, and joints and bearings wear out early.
units.misconception: 單塔斜張橋只要把橋塔做得夠粗，背跨長短就不重要。~In a single-pylon cable-stayed bridge the back-span length does not matter as long as the pylon is massive enough.
units.practice: 計算書應列出背跨壓重、錨墩拉力與背索力在每一施工階段與成橋狀態的包絡值，並把錨墩支承反力列為合龍前的停留檢查點，由設計單位簽認後才可進行下一階段。~The calculations should tabulate envelopes of back-span ballast, anchor-pier tension and back-stay force for every construction stage and the completed state, and anchor-pier bearing reactions should be a hold point before closure, released only after the designer signs off.

units.anchor: HFR 液壓保險阻尼器~Hydraulic fuse restraints
units.title: 縱向浮動體系：HFR、FVD 與位移上限~Longitudinal floating system: HFR, FVD and displacement limits
units.mechanism: 公路局公開資料指出，淡江大橋縱向在主橋塔設 7 支 HFR、橋梁兩端設 4 支 FVD；橫向以內側橋墩頂的 FPB 鋼製摩擦單擺支承與八里側合成橡膠墊消能。HFR 在平時像剛性保險栓，承受煞車與風力而不讓橋面漂移；地震力超過臨界值時保險動作，轉為黏滯阻尼器，讓橋面在約 40 cm 可消能位移內擺動，最後 5 cm 作為防止橋面撞擊橋塔的止擋。這種先剛後柔的安排，把常時的使用性與大地震的消能分開設計。~Published Highway Bureau data state that the Danjiang Bridge has 7 HFR units at the main pylon and 4 FVD units at the bridge ends in the longitudinal direction, while transversely friction-pendulum steel bearings on the inner pier tops and elastomeric pads on the Bali side dissipate energy. In service the HFR behaves like a rigid fuse, carrying braking and wind forces so the deck does not drift; when seismic force exceeds the threshold, the fuse releases and the unit becomes a viscous damper, letting the deck move within roughly 40 cm of dissipative travel, with a final 5 cm acting as a stop that keeps the deck from striking the pylon. Stiff-then-soft behaviour separates everyday serviceability from energy dissipation in a large earthquake.
units.model: 公開資料 7 支 HFR 合計約 5,250 t，平均每支約 750 t（約 7,360 kN）。端部 FVD 取 F = C·v^α，若設計力 9,810 kN 發生在 v = 0.8 m/s、α = 0.3，C = 9,810/0.8^0.3 ≈ 10,490 kN/(m/s)^0.3；v 只有 0.2 m/s 時 F ≈ 10,490×0.617 ≈ 6,470 kN。α 與速度為教學假設。~The published total of about 5,250 t for 7 HFR units averages about 750 t (about 7,360 kN) each. For an end FVD with F = C·v^α, a design force of 9,810 kN at v = 0.8 m/s with α = 0.3 gives C = 9,810/0.8^0.3 ≈ 10,490 kN/(m/s)^0.3; at only 0.2 m/s, F ≈ 10,490×0.617 ≈ 6,470 kN. α and velocities are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每支阻尼器出廠前做原型與逐件試驗：HFR 驗證保險觸發力與觸發後的力—速度曲線，FVD 在多個速度與溫度下繪製遲滯迴圈；安裝後量測橋面與橋塔間的實際間隙，確認 40 cm 消能行程與 5 cm 止擋皆符合圖說。~Each device receives prototype and production tests before delivery: for the HFR, verify the fuse release force and the post-release force–velocity curve; for the FVD, plot hysteresis loops at several velocities and temperatures. After installation measure the actual deck-to-pylon gaps and confirm the 40 cm dissipative travel and 5 cm stop match the drawings.
units.failure: 若保險觸發力設定太低，強烈東北季風或煞車就可能誤觸發，使橋面在常時漂移；設定太高則地震時不觸發，地震力直接灌入橋塔基礎。行程不足時橋面在大地震末段撞擊止擋，產生衝擊力與局部損傷。~A fuse set too low can be triggered by strong northeast-monsoon wind or braking, letting the deck drift in service; set too high it does not release in an earthquake and the full seismic force goes into the pylon foundation. Insufficient stroke lets the deck hit the stops late in a large earthquake, producing impact forces and local damage.
units.misconception: 阻尼器裝得越多越硬，橋梁在地震中就越安全。~The more and stiffer the dampers, the safer the bridge is in an earthquake.
units.practice: 保險觸發力、阻尼係數與行程必須同時列在設計圖與採購規範，並與風、煞車、溫度與地震的荷載組合逐一對照；HFR 與 FVD 的更換程序與臨時固定方式要在交接文件中寫明。~Fuse release force, damping coefficient and stroke must all appear on the drawings and in the procurement specification and be checked against each wind, braking, temperature and seismic combination; replacement procedures and temporary restraint methods for the HFR and FVD units belong in the handover documents.

units.anchor: 主跨遠端長索~Far main-span stay
units.title: 斜拉索力、鋼絞線數與使用應力~Stay force, strand count and service stress
units.mechanism: 淡江大橋以 94 根斜拉索把鋼箱梁吊到單一橋塔，主跨遠端的索最長、最平。每根索要承擔所在節塊的分擔長度內的橋面重、鋪面與活載，但索越平，相同垂直分力需要的索力越大，所以遠端長索通常是鋼絞線數最多的一組。設計時以使用狀態的索力除以每股容許力決定股數，並按標準錨具規格向上取整，同時保留更換單股與日後調索的裕度。~The Danjiang Bridge hangs its steel box girder from a single pylon with 94 stays, and the stays at the far end of the main span are the longest and flattest. Each stay carries the deck weight, surfacing and live load over its tributary length, but the flatter the stay, the larger the force needed for the same vertical component, so the far long stays usually have the most strands. The strand count is set by dividing the service force by the allowable force per strand and rounding up to a standard anchorage size, leaving margin for single-strand replacement and future force adjustment.
units.model: 取塔頂高出橋面 185 m、錨點水平距 430 m，sinθ = 185/√(185²+430²) = 185/468.1 ≈ 0.395；分擔 15 m×300 kN/m = 4,500 kN，T = 4,500/0.395 ≈ 11,390 kN，乘 1.25 計活載與附加靜載得約 14,230 kN。15.7 mm 鋼絞線 GUTS = 150×1,860 = 279 kN，0.45 GUTS = 125.6 kN，需 14,230/125.6 ≈ 114 股，取 127 股錨具。數值為教學假設。~With the anchorage 185 m below the pylon head and 430 m away horizontally, sinθ = 185/√(185²+430²) = 185/468.1 ≈ 0.395; a tributary load of 15 m×300 kN/m = 4,500 kN gives T = 4,500/0.395 ≈ 11,390 kN, and a 1.25 factor for live and superimposed load gives about 14,230 kN. A 15.7 mm strand has GUTS = 150×1,860 = 279 kN and 0.45 GUTS = 125.6 kN, so 14,230/125.6 ≈ 114 strands are needed and a 127-strand anchorage is chosen. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 比對設計索力表與鋼絞線出廠拉伸、鬆弛與疲勞試驗報告，確認每批鋼絞線的破斷力與彈性模數；錨具系統依斜索規範做組裝體疲勞與破斷試驗，並在張拉紀錄中逐根核對最終索力與使用應力比。~Compare the design stay-force table with mill tensile, relaxation and fatigue reports for the strand, confirming breaking force and modulus for each lot; the anchorage system receives assembly fatigue and ultimate tests under stay-cable recommendations, and the stressing records are checked stay by stay for final force and service stress ratio.
units.failure: 若只按恆載挑選股數而忽略活載、溫差與單索斷失的重分配，使用應力可能接近或超過容許值，長期在錨頭產生較大的疲勞應力幅，並使日後無法安全地單股更換。~Selecting strands for dead load only, ignoring live load, temperature and redistribution after a stay loss, can push service stress close to or beyond the limit, raising fatigue stress ranges at the anchor heads and making later single-strand replacement unsafe.
units.misconception: 斜拉索越陡越省鋼，所以長索的股數應該比短索少。~Steeper stays use less steel, so long stays should have fewer strands than short ones.
units.practice: 索力表要同時列出成橋索力、使用最大索力、單索斷失工況與更換工況，錨具尺寸按最不利者決定；圖說應註明每根索的股數、錨具型號與預留調整量。~The stay-force table should list completed-state force, maximum service force, stay-loss and replacement cases, with anchorage size governed by the worst; drawings should state each stay’s strand count, anchorage type and reserved adjustment.

units.anchor: P130 大體積樁帽~P130 mass-concrete pile cap
units.title: 58 支全套管基樁與大體積樁帽水化熱~The 58-pile foundation and mass-concrete cap hydration
units.mechanism: 主塔基礎由 58 支直徑 2.5 m、長約 65 m 的全套管基樁貫入大南灣層，上方是平面約 77 m × 45 m 的大型樁帽，依公開報導約 15,000 m³ 混凝土連續澆置約 93 小時。樁群把塔與斜索的巨大垂直力分散到深層地盤，樁帽頂設在既有河床以下以減輕沖刷。如此厚的樁帽在水化期間核心溫度上升遠高於表面，內外溫差造成的拉應力若超過早齡期混凝土抗拉強度，就會出現溫度裂縫，成為日後鹽害侵入的通道。~The main-pylon foundation uses 58 fully cased bored piles, 2.5 m in diameter and about 65 m long, driven into the Dananwan layer, under a pile cap of about 77 m × 45 m in plan; public reports describe about 15,000 m³ of concrete placed continuously over about 93 hours. The pile group spreads the large vertical forces of pylon and stays into deep ground, and the cap top lies below the existing riverbed to reduce scour. In a cap this thick the core temperature during hydration rises far above the surface, and if the tensile stress from the temperature difference exceeds the early-age tensile strength, thermal cracks form and later become paths for chloride ingress.
units.model: 絕熱溫升 ΔT = C·Q/(ρ·c)。取有效水泥量 C = 350 kg/m³、Q = 300 kJ/kg、ρ·c = 2,400 kJ/(m³·K)：ΔT = 350×300/2,400 ≈ 44 °C；改用摻料使有效水泥量降為 250 kg/m³，ΔT ≈ 31 °C。93 小時澆置 15,000 m³ 需平均約 161 m³/h 的供料率。配比數值為教學假設。~Adiabatic temperature rise ΔT = C·Q/(ρ·c). With effective cement C = 350 kg/m³, Q = 300 kJ/kg and ρ·c = 2,400 kJ/(m³·K), ΔT = 350×300/2,400 ≈ 44 °C; lowering effective cement to 250 kg/m³ with supplementary materials gives ΔT ≈ 31 °C. Placing 15,000 m³ in 93 hours needs an average supply of about 161 m³/h. Mix values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 澆置前做溫度應力分析並訂出核心與表面溫差上限（例如 20 °C 等級），樁帽內埋設多層熱電偶連續記錄；基樁以靜載或雙向載重試驗與完整性檢測（聲波或熱完整性）驗收，比對設計承載與沉陷。~Before casting, run a thermal-stress analysis and set a core-to-surface limit (for example of the order of 20 °C), embedding thermocouples at several levels in the cap with continuous logging; accept piles with static or bidirectional load tests and integrity tests (sonic or thermal) compared against design capacity and settlement.
units.failure: 連續澆置中斷形成冷縫，或保溫不足使表面急冷，樁帽會出現貫穿或表層溫度裂縫；在河口鹽害與潮汐乾濕交替下，裂縫加速氯離子侵入，使鋼筋提前腐蝕。~An interrupted pour that leaves a cold joint, or poor insulation that chills the surface, produces through or surface thermal cracks in the cap; under estuary salt exposure and tidal wetting and drying, the cracks accelerate chloride ingress and early corrosion of the reinforcement.
units.misconception: 大體積混凝土只要強度夠，水化熱不會影響耐久性。~As long as mass concrete reaches its strength, hydration heat does not affect durability.
units.practice: 大體積澆置前要有供料、泵送與備援計畫（第二座拌合廠、備用泵車）、分層澆置順序、測溫與保溫措施，並把溫差超限列為停止與通報條件，由監造與設計單位共同認可。~Before a mass pour require a supply, pumping and backup plan (second batching plant, standby pumps), a layer sequence, temperature monitoring and insulation, with exceedance of the temperature difference as a stop-and-report condition approved by both the supervising engineer and the designer.

units.anchor: 橋塔 53 個昇層~The 53 pylon lifts
units.title: 211 m 曲面橋塔的昇層施工與日照偏位~Lift-by-lift construction and solar sway of the 211 m curved pylon
units.mechanism: 淡江大橋橋塔高約 211 m，是三維曲面的單柱混凝土塔，公開報導指出以 53 個每層約 4 m 的昇層施築。曲面塔每一層的斷面形狀與中心都不同，模板必須逐層變形，且自重偏心會讓塔身在施工中逐漸彎曲；同時，太陽照射一側使塔身兩面溫差數度，就足以讓塔頂偏移十幾到數十公分。因此測量定位不能只看當下讀數，而要把溫度、自重偏心與後續斜索張拉造成的變形一起預測，才能讓完成時的塔軸落在設計位置。~The Danjiang pylon is about 211 m tall, a single concrete mast with a three-dimensional curved surface, and public reports state it was built in 53 lifts of about 4 m. Each lift of a curved pylon has a different shape and centroid, so the formwork must change lift by lift, and the self-weight eccentricity gradually bends the shaft during construction. At the same time, sunlight on one side creates a temperature difference of a few degrees across the section, enough to move the top by tens of centimetres. Setting-out therefore cannot rely on the instantaneous reading; temperature, self-weight eccentricity and later stay stressing must be predicted together so that the completed axis lands in its design position.
units.model: 線性溫差下懸臂塔頂偏位 Δ = α·ΔT·H²/(2b)。取 α = 1.0×10⁻⁵/°C、斷面兩側溫差 ΔT = 10 °C、塔高 H = 200 m、斷面深 b = 8 m：Δ = 10⁻⁵×10×200²/(2×8) = 0.25 m；溫差降為 5 °C 時約 0.125 m。53 層×4 m = 212 m，與公開塔高約 211 m 一致。斷面與溫差為教學假設。~For a linear temperature difference the cantilever tip displacement is Δ = α·ΔT·H²/(2b). With α = 1.0×10⁻⁵/°C, a 10 °C difference across the section, H = 200 m and section depth b = 8 m, Δ = 10⁻⁵×10×200²/(2×8) = 0.25 m; a 5 °C difference gives about 0.125 m. 53 lifts × 4 m = 212 m, consistent with the published height of about 211 m. Section and temperature values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每一昇層在清晨溫度均勻時以全站儀與 GNSS 量測控制點，並同步讀取塔身溫度計；把實測與施工階段分析的預測偏位比對，再以三維雷射掃描與 BIM 模型比對曲面形狀，偏差超過允許值時調整下一層模板定位。~For each lift survey the control points at dawn, when temperature is uniform, with total station and GNSS while reading embedded thermometers; compare measured with predicted displacements from the staged analysis, compare the curved surface with the BIM model by 3D laser scanning, and adjust the next lift’s formwork when deviations exceed tolerance.
units.failure: 若在午後量測並直接以讀數修正模板，會把暫時的日照偏位當成永久誤差，累積數層後塔軸偏離設計線；曲面模板定位錯誤還會使鋼筋保護層不足或錨固箱位置偏移，影響斜索角度。~Surveying in the afternoon and correcting the formwork directly from the reading treats temporary solar sway as permanent error, and after several lifts the axis drifts off the design line; mispositioned curved formwork can also reduce cover or shift anchor boxes, changing stay angles.
units.misconception: 塔頂量到偏位，就代表施工做歪了，必須立即拉回。~Any measured pylon-top offset means the pylon was built crooked and must be pulled back at once.
units.practice: 測量程序應規定量測時段、溫度紀錄與預拱值表，模板定位以預測的「施工時應在位置」放樣而非設計最終座標；曲面塔每批昇層的掃描比對結果要經測量技師與設計單位共同簽認。~The survey procedure should specify measurement times, temperature records and a pre-set table, setting formwork to the predicted as-built-at-this-stage position rather than final design coordinates; scan comparisons for each batch of curved lifts are co-signed by the surveyor and the designer.

units.title: 鋼箱梁懸臂吊裝與合龍溫度窗口~Cantilever erection and the closure temperature window
units.mechanism: 淡江大橋鋼箱梁以船運到橋下、由懸臂端吊裝，公開報導指出一般節塊約 400 至 500 t，全橋採全焊接以減輕約一成重量。最後的八里側 26 號合龍節塊長約 15.2 m、寬約 51.3 m、重約 390 t，選在漲潮時段吊裝以免駁船擱淺，吊裝前一天早、中、晚量測橋面高程與伸縮。懸臂鋼梁會隨溫度伸縮與起伏，合龍口的長度與高差在一天內持續改變；合龍前的大懸臂在強風下也曾出現約 40 cm 的擺動，所以合龍必須在溫度與風況都穩定的窗口完成。~The Danjiang steel box girder segments were barged to the site and lifted at the cantilever tips; public reports cite typical segments of about 400 to 500 t, with full welding saving about a tenth of the weight. The final closure segment no. 26 on the Bali side is about 15.2 m long, 51.3 m wide and 390 t, lifted at high tide so the barge would not ground, after deck levels and expansion were measured morning, noon and evening the day before. A steel cantilever lengthens and rises or falls with temperature, so the closure gap’s length and level difference change throughout the day; before closure the long cantilever was also reported to sway about 40 cm in strong wind, so closure must be completed in a window of stable temperature and wind.
units.model: 合龍口長度變化 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。取鋼 α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C、自固定點起算 L = 430 m、早晚溫差 ΔT = 15 °C：ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×430×15 ≈ 0.077 m，即約 77 mm；若只差 5 °C 則約 26 mm。溫度與長度為教學假設。~Change in closure-gap length ΔL = α·L·ΔT. With steel α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C, L = 430 m from the fixed point and a 15 °C morning-to-afternoon difference, ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×430×15 ≈ 0.077 m, about 77 mm; a 5 °C difference gives about 26 mm. Temperatures and length are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 合龍前連續 24 至 72 小時記錄合龍口長度、高差、橋面溫度與風速，回歸出長度—溫度關係，選定合龍溫度並據以決定節塊配切長度；吊裝後先以臨時鎖定裝置固定，再於預定溫度區間內完成焊接，並複量全橋線形與索力。~Record gap length, level difference, deck temperature and wind speed continuously for 24 to 72 hours before closure, regress length against temperature, choose the closure temperature and set the segment’s trimmed length; after lifting, lock the segment with temporary devices, complete welding within the chosen temperature band and re-survey the profile and stay forces.
units.failure: 未依溫度窗口配切或鎖定，合龍口在焊接期間張開或擠壓，造成焊道開裂、內應力殘留或強迫頂推；若在強風擺動中強行對位，吊具與臨時連接可能承受衝擊，危及作業人員。~Without trimming and locking to the temperature window, the gap opens or closes during welding, cracking welds, leaving residual stress or forcing the cantilevers apart; forcing alignment while the cantilever sways in wind can shock-load rigging and temporary connections and endanger the crew.
units.misconception: 合龍節塊只要照設計圖長度製造，任何時間都能吊上去對接。~A closure segment made to the drawing length can be lifted and joined at any time of day.
units.practice: 合龍作業應有獨立的施工計畫：量測期、溫度與風速作業門檻、潮位窗口、臨時鎖定順序、焊接程序與中止條件，並由監造單位設為停留檢查點，未經簽認不得解除臨時鎖定。~Closure needs its own method statement: measurement period, temperature and wind thresholds, tidal window, temporary locking sequence, welding procedure and abort criteria, with the supervising engineer holding a hold point so temporary locks are not released without sign-off.

units.anchor: 斷面與全橋風洞模型~Section and full-bridge wind models
units.title: 風洞試驗與渦致振動判讀~Wind-tunnel testing and vortex-induced vibration
units.mechanism: 公路局公開資料指出，淡江大橋以斷面模型與全橋模型風洞試驗輔以數值分析，檢查施工階段與完工後的穩定、車輛與行人舒適性及纜索風致振動，並以 1:200 模型測試獨立橋塔，結果未見氣動或氣彈不穩定。鋼箱梁在中低風速下最常見的問題是渦致振動：氣流在箱梁下游交替脫落渦流，頻率接近橋面的垂直或扭轉頻率時產生有限振幅的鎖定振動。欄杆、防風屏與檢修車軌道都會改變斷面形狀，因此試驗模型必須包含這些附屬物。~Highway Bureau data state that the Danjiang Bridge was checked by section-model and full-bridge wind-tunnel tests supported by numerical analysis for stability during construction and in service, vehicle and pedestrian comfort and wind-induced cable vibration, with a 1:200 model of the free-standing pylon, and that no aerodynamic or aeroelastic instability was found. The commonest problem for a steel box deck at low and moderate wind is vortex-induced vibration: vortices shed alternately behind the box and, when their frequency approaches a vertical or torsional deck frequency, cause limited-amplitude lock-in. Railings, wind screens and inspection-gantry rails all change the section shape, so test models must include them.
units.model: 渦流脫落鎖定風速 U = f·D/St。取垂直彎曲頻率 f = 0.35 Hz、箱梁含附屬物的特徵高度 D = 3.5 m、St = 0.10：U = 0.35×3.5/0.10 ≈ 12.3 m/s；若欄杆改變使 St 變為 0.12，U ≈ 10.2 m/s。這屬日常季風風速範圍，所以要靠試驗確認振幅。數值為教學假設。~Vortex lock-in wind speed U = f·D/St. With vertical bending frequency f = 0.35 Hz, characteristic depth including attachments D = 3.5 m and St = 0.10, U = 0.35×3.5/0.10 ≈ 12.3 m/s; if railings change St to 0.12, U ≈ 10.2 m/s. These are everyday monsoon wind speeds, so amplitudes must be confirmed by testing. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 斷面模型以彈簧懸掛做自由振動與風速掃描，記錄振幅—風速曲線並換算成實橋加速度，與行人與行車舒適準則比較；全橋氣彈模型檢查施工最長懸臂與成橋狀態；完工後以橋面加速度計與風速計長期紀錄，比對實測鎖定風速與振幅。~Spring-mount the section model for free-vibration and wind-speed sweeps, record amplitude versus wind speed, scale to full-size acceleration and compare with pedestrian and driving comfort criteria; use the full aeroelastic model for the longest construction cantilever and the completed state; after completion log deck accelerometers and anemometers long term and compare measured lock-in speeds and amplitudes.
units.failure: 完工後更換欄杆或加裝屏障而未重新評估，可能讓原本安全的斷面出現渦振或噪音；淡江大橋通車後曾有東北季風吹過欄杆產生低頻聲響的反映，顯示附屬物的氣動細節同樣影響使用性。~Changing railings or adding screens after completion without re-evaluation can introduce vortex vibration or noise in a previously safe section; after the Danjiang Bridge opened, low-frequency sound from northeast-monsoon wind passing the railings was reported, showing that attachment details also affect serviceability.
units.misconception: 風洞試驗只需要檢查颱風時會不會顫振，中低風速不必關心。~Wind-tunnel testing only needs to check flutter in typhoons; low and moderate wind speeds do not matter.
units.practice: 任何欄杆、防風屏、燈桿或標誌的形狀變更，都應回送風工程顧問評估是否需補做斷面試驗；施工最長懸臂狀態要訂出停工風速與臨時抗風措施。~Any change to railings, wind screens, lighting columns or signs should go back to the wind consultant to decide whether further section tests are needed; the longest-cantilever stage needs a stop-work wind speed and temporary wind measures.

units.anchor: 通車前載重試驗~Pre-opening load test
units.title: 載重試驗與實測勁度比對~Load testing and measured stiffness
units.mechanism: 淡江大橋在通車前安排斜拉索重新張拉檢查與載重試驗。載重試驗以已知重量的卡車車隊在預定位置停放，量測主跨撓度、塔頂偏位、索力增量與關鍵斷面應變，再與結構模型在相同載重下的預測比較。實測撓度略小於預測通常代表實際勁度較高（鋪面、欄杆參與），若明顯大於預測或卸載後殘留變形過大，則可能有支承、索力或連接的問題。這些結果也成為日後監測的基準狀態。~Before opening, the Danjiang Bridge scheduled stay re-tensioning checks and a load test. A load test parks a fleet of trucks of known weight at planned positions and measures main-span deflection, pylon-top displacement, stay-force increments and strains at key sections, compared with the structural model’s predictions under the same load. Measured deflection slightly below prediction usually means real stiffness is higher (surfacing and railings participate); deflection clearly above prediction, or large residual deformation after unloading, may point to bearing, stay-force or connection problems. The results also become the baseline for later monitoring.
units.model: 16 輛 35 t 卡車合計 560 t（約 5,494 kN）置於主跨中段，模型預測撓度 0.45 m，等效勁度 k = 5,494/0.45 ≈ 12,200 kN/m；實測 0.40 m，實測／計算比 = 0.40/0.45 ≈ 0.89；卸載後殘留 0.03 m，殘留率 0.03/0.40 = 7.5%。數值為教學假設。~Sixteen 35 t trucks, 560 t in total (about 5,494 kN), are placed near mid main span; the model predicts 0.45 m of deflection, an equivalent stiffness k = 5,494/0.45 ≈ 12,200 kN/m. Measured deflection is 0.40 m, a measured-to-calculated ratio of 0.40/0.45 ≈ 0.89; a residual of 0.03 m after unloading is 0.03/0.40 = 7.5%. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 試驗計畫事先列出載重位置、分級加載、量測點（GNSS、水準、應變計、索力計）、穩定判定與允收準則（例如實測／計算比落在約 0.7 至 1.0、殘留率低於約 20%）；量測同步記錄溫度，必要時以空載基準扣除溫度變形。~The test plan lists load positions, load steps, measurement points (GNSS, levelling, strain gauges, stay-force sensors), stabilisation criteria and acceptance limits (for example a measured-to-calculated ratio of about 0.7 to 1.0 and residual below about 20%), with temperature recorded simultaneously so thermal deformation can be removed against an unloaded baseline.
units.failure: 若試驗在日照強烈時進行且未修正溫度，橋面熱變形可能與載重撓度同量級，使判讀失真；若比值異常卻直接放行通車，可能錯過支承卡死、索力分配錯誤或焊接缺陷等早期問題。~Testing in strong sunshine without temperature correction lets thermal deck movement reach the same order as load deflection and distorts interpretation; opening the bridge despite abnormal ratios can miss early problems such as seized bearings, misallocated stay forces or weld defects.
units.misconception: 載重試驗撓度比計算值小，就代表設計太保守、浪費材料。~A load-test deflection smaller than calculated means the design was overly conservative and wasteful.
units.practice: 載重試驗要與索力復測、支承與伸縮縫位置紀錄一起做成成橋基準檔案；卡車重量需經地磅秤重並存證，試驗期間封閉交通並由專人指揮車隊定位。~Combine the load test with stay-force re-measurement and records of bearing and joint positions into the as-completed baseline file; weigh each truck on a certified weighbridge, keep the tickets, close the bridge during the test and have a marshal position the trucks.

units.anchor: U 肋與橫隔板交接~Rib-to-diaphragm joints
units.title: 正交異性鋼橋面的疲勞壽命與鋪面勁度~Orthotropic-deck fatigue life and surfacing stiffness
units.mechanism: 淡江大橋鋼箱梁採全焊接，橋面板上鋪 GUSS 澆注式瀝青。正交異性橋面的疲勞熱點集中在輪載正下方：U 肋與面板的縱向焊道、U 肋穿過橫隔板的切口，以及現場對接的 U 肋接頭。鋪面不是只有防水與行車舒適的功能，它與鋼板共同受力時能明顯降低局部應力幅；但瀝青模數隨溫度大幅下降，夏季高溫時鋪面參與度變低，焊道承受的應力幅變大。疲勞評估因此必須同時考慮細節分類、交通量與鋪面溫度。~The Danjiang steel box girder is fully welded and its deck plate is surfaced with GUSS mastic asphalt. Fatigue hot spots in an orthotropic deck concentrate under the wheels: longitudinal rib-to-deck welds, the cut-outs where U-ribs pass through diaphragms, and site butt splices of the ribs. The surfacing is not only for waterproofing and ride; acting together with the plate it markedly lowers local stress ranges. Asphalt stiffness, however, drops sharply with temperature, so in hot summers the surfacing contributes less and the welds see larger stress ranges. Fatigue assessment must therefore combine detail category, traffic volume and surfacing temperature.
units.model: S–N 曲線 N = 2×10⁶×(Δσ_C/Δσ)³。取細節類別 Δσ_C = 71 MPa：夏季鋪面軟化時 Δσ = 60 MPa，N ≈ 2×10⁶×1.657 ≈ 3.3×10⁶ 次；冬季鋪面參與時 Δσ = 40 MPa，N ≈ 2×10⁶×5.59 ≈ 1.1×10⁷ 次，壽命比為 (60/40)³ ≈ 3.4。應力幅為教學假設。~S–N curve N = 2×10⁶×(Δσ_C/Δσ)³. With detail category Δσ_C = 71 MPa, a summer stress range of 60 MPa with softened surfacing gives N ≈ 2×10⁶×1.657 ≈ 3.3×10⁶ cycles, while a winter range of 40 MPa with the surfacing acting gives N ≈ 2×10⁶×5.59 ≈ 1.1×10⁷ cycles, a life ratio of (60/40)³ ≈ 3.4. Stress ranges are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 現場對接焊道以超音波或相位陣列檢測驗收，並以應變計在重車道下方量測不同季節的應力幅，配合動態地磅的軸重頻譜，以 Miner 累積損傷法比對設計假設；定期以目視與磁粒檢測巡查 U 肋切口與焊趾。~Accept site butt welds by ultrasonic or phased-array testing, gauge stress ranges under the heavy-vehicle lane in different seasons, combine them with axle-load spectra from weigh-in-motion and compare with design assumptions using Miner’s cumulative damage; inspect rib cut-outs and weld toes periodically by visual and magnetic-particle testing.
units.failure: U 肋與面板焊道的根部裂縫可能向面板內擴展，在鋪面下方難以發現，直到鋪面出現縱向裂紋或滲水；高溫季節長期重車會加速裂縫成長，修補需要封閉車道並刨除鋪面。~Root cracks in rib-to-deck welds can grow into the deck plate, hidden beneath the surfacing until longitudinal cracks or water seepage appear in the pavement; sustained heavy traffic in hot seasons accelerates growth, and repair requires lane closures and removal of the surfacing.
units.misconception: 鋼橋面疲勞只跟鋼板厚度有關，鋪面材料和季節溫度不影響。~Steel-deck fatigue depends only on plate thickness; surfacing material and seasonal temperature have no effect.
units.practice: 鋪面更換或改用不同材料前，必須評估其模數與溫度特性對鋼橋面應力幅的影響；巡檢計畫應把重車道下方的 U 肋接頭列為優先檢查區，並保存每次檢測的裂縫位置圖。~Before resurfacing or changing material, assess how its modulus and temperature behaviour change deck stress ranges; the inspection plan should prioritise rib splices under the heavy-vehicle lane and keep a crack-location map from each inspection.

units.anchor: 24 小時監測系統~24-hour monitoring system
units.title: 監測資料的溫度修正與構件更換決策~Temperature-corrected monitoring and component replacement decisions
units.mechanism: 公路局資料指出，淡江大橋設有橋檢桁架，並對橋塔、斜拉索、鋼箱梁與 P120、P140 墩進行 24 小時監測；斜拉索、支承、阻尼器與伸縮縫都設計為可更換，以配合 120 年使用年限。監測數據最大的干擾來自溫度：一天內索力、塔頂偏位與伸縮縫開口都隨溫度變化，若直接拿原始讀數與基準比較，會把正常的熱效應誤判為損傷。工程師要先建立每個量測值與溫度的回歸關係，把讀數換算到基準溫度，再以偏差趨勢決定是否調索、檢修或更換構件。~Highway Bureau data state that the Danjiang Bridge has an inspection gantry and 24-hour monitoring of the pylon, stays, steel box girder and piers P120 and P140, and that stays, bearings, dampers and expansion joints are designed to be replaceable for a 120-year service life. The largest disturbance in the data is temperature: stay forces, pylon-top displacement and joint openings all change through the day, and comparing raw readings directly with the baseline mistakes normal thermal effects for damage. Engineers first regress each measured quantity against temperature, convert readings to a reference temperature, then use the trend of deviations to decide on force adjustment, repair or replacement.
units.model: 溫度修正 T_ref = T_meas − k·(t − t_ref)。某索溫度係數 k = −8 kN/°C，32 °C 時實測 5,960 kN，換算到 20 °C：T_20 = 5,960 − (−8)×(32 − 20) = 6,056 kN；與基準 6,100 kN 相差 −44 kN，約 −0.7%，在 ±5% 警戒內。數值為教學假設。~Temperature correction T_ref = T_meas − k·(t − t_ref). For a stay with k = −8 kN/°C measuring 5,960 kN at 32 °C, the 20 °C value is T_20 = 5,960 − (−8)×(32 − 20) = 6,056 kN; against a 6,100 kN baseline the difference is −44 kN, about −0.7%, inside a ±5% alert band. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以通車初期至少一整年的資料建立各感測器的溫度回歸與季節基準，設定警戒與行動兩級門檻；異常時先檢查感測器漂移與時間同步，再以人工量測（例如振動法索力或精密水準）複核，最後才判定結構變化。~Use at least one full year of early-service data to build temperature regressions and seasonal baselines for each sensor, with alert and action thresholds; on an anomaly first check sensor drift and time synchronisation, then confirm by independent manual measurement such as vibration-based stay force or precise levelling, and only then conclude a structural change.
units.failure: 未做溫度修正時，夏季索力下降可能被誤判為索力損失而進行不必要的調索；反之真正的錨具滑移或阻尼器失效可能被季節波動掩蓋，等到出現明顯變形才發現。~Without temperature correction, a summer drop in stay force can be misread as force loss and trigger unnecessary re-tensioning; conversely real anchor slip or damper failure can hide inside seasonal swings until visible deformation appears.
units.misconception: 裝了 24 小時監測系統，就可以取代人工巡檢。~A 24-hour monitoring system can replace manual inspection.
units.practice: 交接文件要包含感測器清單與位置、校正紀錄、溫度回歸係數、門檻值與通報流程，並規定任何構件更換（索、支承、阻尼器、伸縮縫）前後都要重做局部基準量測與紀錄。~Handover documents should include the sensor list and locations, calibration records, temperature regression coefficients, thresholds and reporting procedure, and require new local baseline measurements before and after any replacement of stays, bearings, dampers or joints.

example: 設計練習：某長索使用索力 T = 6,000 kN，以 61 股 15.7 mm 鋼絞線組成，A = 61×150 = 9,150 mm²，E = 195 GPa，索長 L = 300 m，水平投影 L_h = 280 m。使用應力 σ = 6,000,000/9,150 ≈ 656 MPa，約為 GUTS 1,860 MPa 的 35%。張拉伸長量 ΔL = T·L/(E·A) = 6,000,000×300,000/(195,000×9,150) ≈ 1,009 mm。考慮垂度的 Ernst 等效模數 E_eq = E/[1 + (γ·L_h)²·E/(12σ³)]，取含套管的等效單位重 γ = 1.02×10⁻⁴ N/mm³：(γ·L_h)² = (1.02×10⁻⁴×280,000)² ≈ 816 N²/mm⁴，乘 E 再除以 12σ³ 得 0.047，E_eq ≈ 195/1.047 ≈ 186 GPa。若在施工早期索力只有一半（σ ≈ 328 MPa），比值變為 0.376，E_eq ≈ 142 GPa，長索明顯變軟，施工階段分析必須逐階段更新等效模數。數值為教學假設，不代表淡江大橋的設計。~Design exercise: a long stay carries a service force T = 6,000 kN with 61 strands of 15.7 mm, A = 61×150 = 9,150 mm², E = 195 GPa, length L = 300 m and horizontal projection L_h = 280 m. The service stress is σ = 6,000,000/9,150 ≈ 656 MPa, about 35% of the 1,860 MPa GUTS. The stressing elongation is ΔL = T·L/(E·A) = 6,000,000×300,000/(195,000×9,150) ≈ 1,009 mm. The Ernst equivalent modulus for sag is E_eq = E/[1 + (γ·L_h)²·E/(12σ³)]; with an equivalent unit weight including the duct of γ = 1.02×10⁻⁴ N/mm³, (γ·L_h)² = (1.02×10⁻⁴×280,000)² ≈ 816 N²/mm⁴, and multiplying by E and dividing by 12σ³ gives 0.047, so E_eq ≈ 195/1.047 ≈ 186 GPa. If the force is only half during early erection (σ ≈ 328 MPa), the ratio becomes 0.376 and E_eq ≈ 142 GPa: the long stay is much softer, so the staged analysis must update the equivalent modulus stage by stage. Values are teaching assumptions, not the Danjiang Bridge design.
history: 淡江大橋計畫於 2014 年由行政院核定，2015 年國際競圖由札哈・哈蒂建築師事務所與中興工程顧問、德國 Leonhardt, Andrä und Partner 團隊勝出，以單柱混凝土塔減少視覺與河床干擾，並避開淡水夕照景觀。主橋工程歷經 2017 至 2018 年多次流標，2019 年 2 月由工信工程開工；2025 年 3 月淡水側鋼梁合龍、9 月 16 日八里側合龍，2026 年 5 月 12 日通車，成為主跨最長的單塔不對稱斜張橋，並預留淡海輕軌空間。本課只依公開資料重建工程原理，不代表任何設計或施工文件。~The Danjiang Bridge plan was approved by the Executive Yuan in 2014, and in 2015 an international competition was won by Zaha Hadid Architects with Sinotech Engineering Consultants and Germany’s Leonhardt, Andrä und Partner, whose single concrete mast limits visual and riverbed impact and keeps the Tamsui sunset view open. After repeated failed tenders in 2017 and 2018, main-bridge construction by Kung Sing Engineering began in February 2019; the Tamsui-side girder closed in March 2025 and the Bali-side closure followed on 16 September 2025, and the bridge opened on 12 May 2026 as the longest-span single-pylon asymmetric cable-stayed bridge, with space reserved for the Danhai light rail. This course reconstructs engineering principles from public information only and represents no design or construction document.
facts: 主橋長約 920 m，主跨 450 m、背跨 175 m~The main bridge is about 920 m long with a 450 m main span and a 175 m back span
橋塔高約 211 m（競圖階段約 200 m），以 53 個約 4 m 的昇層施築~The pylon is about 211 m tall (about 200 m at competition stage), built in 53 lifts of about 4 m
全橋共 94 根斜拉索~The bridge has 94 stay cables
縱向設 7 支 HFR（合計約 5,250 t）於主塔、4 支 FVD 於兩端~Longitudinally 7 HFR units (about 5,250 t in total) sit at the pylon and 4 FVD units at the ends
主塔基礎 58 支直徑 2.5 m、長約 65 m 的全套管基樁~The pylon foundation has 58 fully cased bored piles, 2.5 m in diameter and about 65 m long
樁帽平面約 77 m × 45 m，依公開報導約 15,000 m³ 混凝土連續澆置約 93 小時~The pile cap is about 77 m × 45 m in plan, with about 15,000 m³ of concrete placed continuously over about 93 hours
26 號合龍節塊長約 15.2 m、寬約 51.3 m、重約 390 t~Closure segment no. 26 is about 15.2 m long, 51.3 m wide and 390 t
深槽區保留寬 200 m、淨高至少 20 m 的航道~The deep channel keeps a navigation opening 200 m wide with at least 20 m clearance
1:81 水工模型顯示主塔局部沖刷最深約 8.4 m（27 小時洪水延時）~A 1:81 hydraulic model showed maximum local scour of about 8.4 m at the pylon for a 27-hour flood
設計使用年限 120 年，斜拉索、支承、阻尼器與伸縮縫可更換~The design service life is 120 years, with replaceable stays, bearings, dampers and expansion joints
